summary_zh: Audi限量499輛Nuvolari插電式混合超跑，搭載V8引擎與三軸向磁通馬達。

title: Nissan 與合作夥伴合作進行硫基固態電池研究
content: Nissan, the University of Oxford and battery material manufacturer Gelion are launching the research project “Cost-effective, Resilient Solid-state Li–S (CoRe-SoLiS)” this month. The project aims to develop a solid-state lithium-sulphur battery with high charging power, energy density and lifespan.
summary_zh: Nissan與牛津大學及Gelion合作開發低成本硫基固態電池。

title: 歐盟汽車套案：公司車輛的電動配額更高？
content: The EU’s car package may not be finalised until 2027, as Members of the European Parliament continue to debate the specifics of the regulations. One of the key issues is the Social Democrats’ demand for a significantly stricter electric vehicle quota for company car fleets than that proposed by the European Commission.

title: B2U 將使用過的 Waymo 電池重新用於二手能源儲存系統
content: Los Angeles-based energy storage manufacturer B2U Storage Solutions has announced a strategic partnership with robotaxi provider Waymo. The aim of the cooperation is to repurpose batteries from Waymo’s electric vehicle fleet after their decommissioning.
summary_zh: B2U Storage Solutions 宣布與 Waymo 策略合作，將使用過的 Waymo 電池用於能源儲存系統。

title: 布拉格啟用擁有 161 個充電點的充電樞紐
content: Prague has transitioned its largest municipal charging hub into regular operation. In the city’s ninth district (Praha 9), up to 161 vehicles can now charge simultaneously at a single location, primarily via AC chargers, but also at Alpitronic Hyperchargers. The charging park is operated by the energy company PRE, in which the city of Prague holds a stake.

title: Foxtron 以自有品牌推出 Cavira 電動 SUV
content: iPhone contract manufacturer Foxconn is launching an electric SUV called Cavira in Taiwan, Australia and New Zealand through its subsidiary Foxtron, with additional markets to follow. After initially positioning Foxtron as a contract manufacturer for Western automakers, the Cavira is now the second production model under its own brand.
summary_zh: Foxconn 旗下 Foxtron 在台灣、澳洲及紐西蘭推出自有品牌 Cavira 電動 SUV。

title: 荷蘭：Lidl 將在 2027 年前為所有 440 家商店配備電動卡車
content: Lidl aims to supply all its stores in the Netherlands with electric trucks starting next year. According to the company, this target will be achieved three years earlier than previously planned. Stores in the North Holland and Flevoland regions are already being supplied entirely by electric transport.
summary_zh: Lidl 計畫 2027 年前為荷蘭 440 家商店全數配備電動卡車，目標明年開始執行。

title: IONCOR Energy Pack：重型電氣化的緊湊電源
content: When electrifying heavy-duty vehicles or off-highway equipment, system integration quickly becomes the deciding factor. Safety, packaging, certification, durability, and lifecycle cost define competitiveness more than the drivetrain itself. This is where IONCOR’s Energy Pack delivers value, offering a compact, high-performance battery platform for space-constrained, reliability-critical applicatio
summary_zh: IONCOR 推出 Energy Pack，針對重型車輛及非公路設備提供緊湊型電源解決方案。

title: MG4 EV Urban 首次駕駛：不刺激，但出奇地好
content: The new MG4 EV Urban makes its mission clear from the name: everyday usability, commuting and straightforward electric mobility. Instead of relying on large displays, exaggerated sportiness or flashy design, MG Motor takes a pragmatic approach. A first drive through urban traffic, along country roads and on the motorway towards Lake Starnberg reveals whether that concept works in practice.
summary_zh: MG4 EV Urban 強調日常通勤實用性，首駕評測顯示表現平穩但舒適。

title: KIA UK 擴展 PV5 產品線，新增 Cargo 和 Passenger 版本
content: KIA UK has announced that a new entry-level Cargo variant and a seven-seat Passenger model will join its roster of PV5 EVs for MY2027. Additional tweaks and improvements have also been introduced for existing models.
summary_zh: KIA UK 宣布 2027 年式 PV5 新增 Cargo 及七人座 Passenger 版本。

title: Moment Energy 在溫哥華開設新的二手設施
content: Canadian company Moment Energy is on the verge of commissioning a facility for repurposing used electric vehicle batteries in stationary battery energy storage systems (BESS). The factory in Vancouver is expected to reach an annual capacity of 1 GWh soon.
summary_zh: Moment Energy 即將在溫哥華啟用二手電動車電池再利用設施，用於固定式儲能。

title: 據報 Samsung SDI 將向 Volkswagen 供應電池芯
content: Volkswagen is reportedly bringing the South Korean battery manufacturer Samsung SDI on board as an additional supplier for its Unified Cell. The standardised battery cell is currently produced by VW subsidiary PowerCo in Salzgitter and by VW affiliate Gotion in China.
summary_zh: Volkswagen 據報將引進 Samsung SDI 作為 Unified Cell 電池芯額外供應商。

title: 愛爾蘭宣布為 EV 報廢計劃提供 1000 萬歐元資金
content: A newly announced scrappage scheme in Ireland aims to help consumers replace aging ICE vehicles with new battery electric vehicles. Applicants could receive up to €5000 in addition to other grants if they agree to scrap an ICE vehicle registered in 2013 or earlier.
summary_zh: 愛爾蘭推出報廢計劃，提供 1000 萬歐元補助消費者以新 EV 汰換老舊燃油車。

title: 英國 EV 市佔率達到 27.3%，為 2019 年以來最強的五月
content: Battery-electric vehicle registrations in the UK continued to accelerate in May, with BEV volumes rising by 34.2% year-on-year to achieve a market share of 27.3%. According to new figures published by the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), the result marks the highest monthly BEV share recorded so far in 2026.
summary_zh: 英國 5 月 BEV 註冊量年增 34.2%，市佔率達 27.3%，創 2019 年來最強五月。

title: Mercedes F1 車隊在歐洲賽季部署 eActros 600
content: The Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team will use a battery-electric Mercedes-Benz eActros 600 for all nine European Formula One races this year. According to the team, this makes it the first Formula One team to use an electric truck throughout an entire European race season.
summary_zh: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 車隊今年歐洲九站 F1 賽事將使用 eActros 600 電動卡車。

title: Xpeng 將在格拉茲的 Magna Steyr 生產第四款車型
content: Chinese EV firm Xpeng is expanding its collaboration with contract manufacturer Magna Steyr. In addition to the G6, G9, and P7+, a fourth model will also be produced at its plant in Graz, as confirmed by Xpeng CEO He Xiaopeng. However, it remains unclear which vehicle this will be.
summary_zh: Xpeng 擴大與 Magna Steyr 合作，除 G6、G9、P7+ 外將在奧地利格拉茲生產第四款車型。

title: Rivian Adventure Network 宣布快速充電里程碑
content: Californian EV startup Rivian has announced that its fast charging network now has more than 1000 DC fast charging ports located across the USA. Four sites featuring a total of 44 charging stalls were opened in the last month alone.
summary_zh: Rivian 快速充電網絡已超過 1000 個 DC 快充埠，遍布美國各地。

title: Sany 在歐洲交付長途電動卡車
content: Sany has started marketing its e263 electric semi-truck in Europe, with the first customer vehicles now operating in Germany. We have all the details about the Chinese electric truck, including payload, net battery capacity and battery warranty. Sany also announced that it will make a ‘big splash with new models and a preview for 2027’ at IAA Transportation.
summary_zh: Sany 開始在歐洲銷售 e263 電動半卡車，首批車輛已在德國投入營運。

title: GaN4EmoBiL 展示 800 伏雙向 DC 充電器
content: Portuguese charging infrastructure manufacturer i-charging has introduced its new All-in-One 500 (AiO 500) charging system with up to 500 kW of charging power. The station supports CCS, NACS and GB/T standards, covering the most widely used international charging formats. According to the company, the optional liquid-cooled charging cables also enable regular charging for electric trucks.
summary_zh: GaN4EmoBiL 展示 800 伏雙向 DC 充電器，適用電動車雙向充電應用。

content: Seat has announced the start of production for the Volkswagen ID. Polo and the Cupra Raval in Martorell, Spain. For the VW Group, the two compact electric models are among the most important launches of the year. Initially, both vehicles will be built with the larger battery version, while lower-cost variants are set to follow later.

title: Palmer Energy Technology 收購 Kleandrive
content: As part of the GaN4EmoBiL project, Fraunhofer IAF and Ambibox have developed a power electronic module based on gallium nitride for bidirectional DC charging systems with 800 volts. A demonstrator will be presented next week at the PCIM trade fair in Nuremberg.

title: 印度：Tata Motors 將授權 Chery JLR 的 Freelander 平台

The deal is intended to preserve British engineering capabilities in heavy-duty vehicle electrification and retrofit solutions.
